output.brief: The evidence points to the combination of RotaWeave and the loss of site coordinators, not the app alone. Basic-tier RotaWeave has no recurring bookings. A regular keeps a weekly slot only if staff book it before the Thursday release. Coordinators did that booking in April, at about 74 bookings a week across Dock Street and Westgate. After the posts ended on 1 May, it fell to about 3 a week. At those two sites 129 of 213 April regulars lost their usual slot at least twice, and 88% of them are now inactive. Only 11% of those who kept their slot are inactive. Millbrook has the app but kept its coordinator, and it is stable. Quarry Lane lost its coordinator but is not on the app yet, and it is also stable. The background-check renewal doesn't explain it: 121 of the 123 lapsed volunteers held a current check. Commonplate is a negligible factor, with 2 of 61 callbacks. Don't cancel RotaWeave, suspend the checks, or purge the roster. Do put someone on the unused admin seat to book regulars into their usual slots before each Thursday release. Phone lapsed regulars to offer their slot back. Review after 60 days. Plan the Quarry Lane go-live on 6 Oct with the same booking cover. My confidence is fairly high. The site comparison is strong, but the callback sample is small.
